faqs.question: What is TAMYIZ™?
faqs.answer: TAMYIZ™ (https://tamyiz.pages.dev) is a digital publishing platform founded by Sahil Naseer and Basit Majeed, offering DRM-free PDF e-books on practical topics, security, AI, and literary fiction.

faqs.question: Are there any bundle discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes! TAMYIZ™ gives automatic bundle discounts at checkout: **20% off** when buying 2 books, and **25% off** when buying 3 or more books (applied automatically before any promo coupon).

faqs.question: How do I download my e-book after paying?
faqs.answer: TAMYIZ™ e-books are DRM-free PDFs sold securely via Razorpay. Right after payment, your private signed download link appears immediately on screen AND is emailed to you via receipt (valid for 1 year, up to 10 downloads per link).

faqs.question: How do I recover a lost download link?
faqs.answer: If you lost your file, go to https://tamyiz.pages.dev/downloads and enter your order email or 10-digit phone number to have your download links re-sent to your order email. If you reached the 10-download limit, message us on WhatsApp at +91 95417 22379 or email tamyiz.co@gmail.com with your Razorpay payment ID.

faqs.question: Can I read a free sample first?
faqs.answer: Yes! TAMYIZ™ offers a free Chapter 1 sample reader on https://tamyiz.pages.dev so you can preview the writing before purchasing.

faqs.question: How do pre-orders and gift orders work?
faqs.answer: Editions marked 'Coming Soon' can be pre-ordered on WhatsApp (+91 95417 22379). Gift orders and promo coupons are also supported at checkout.

faqs.question: How do I contact TAMYIZ™ support?
